scripts.text: Oh... is it true? You've helped my sis Sneewy? Thank you.
scripts.translation: 哦...真的嗎？你幫過我妹妹斯紐伊？謝謝你。

scripts.text: Snoowy's sent me a bird with a message. She told me about your help...
scripts.translation: 斯諾維給我寄來了一隻帶信的鳥。她告訴我你幫了她的忙...

scripts.text: I'll tell you a secret of the magic rings.
scripts.translation: 我告訴你一個魔法戒指的秘密。

scripts.text: They have magic power only from 8 December till 8 January.
scripts.translation: 它們只有在12月8日至1月8日期間才有魔力。

scripts.text: By the way, just put on Santa's Hat to discover their true power.
scripts.translation: 順便說一句，戴上聖誕帽就能發現它們真正的力量。

scripts.text: If you put on both rings their power would be doubled.
scripts.translation: 如果你同時戴上兩枚戒指，力量就會加倍。

scripts.text: Hi! Two my sisters and I are preparing gifts for the whole 3 holidays!
scripts.translation: 嗨！我和兩個妹妹正在為三個節日準備禮物！

scripts.text: My younger sis Sneewy's left to some faraway land to prepare gifts for their poor children... I don't know where. You should ask my elder sis and her birdies.
scripts.translation: 我妹妹斯紐伊去某個遙遠的地方給那裡的窮孩子準備禮物了...我不知道具體在哪兒。你應該去問我的姐姐和她的小鳥們。

scripts.text: My elder sis? Her name's Snoowy. She's sailed to some green island... She's talking about some gifts for dolphins or something...
scripts.translation: 我的姐姐？她叫斯諾維。她乘船去了某個綠色島嶼...她好像在為海豚什麼的準備禮物...

scripts.text: The whole three holidays? Well they come one after another!
scripts.translation: 三個節日？它們一個接一個地到來！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Karachun^000000? Heh... This is an old pagans festival. They used to celebrate it before the appearance of HNY and XMas, you know.
scripts.translation: ^FF0000卡拉春節^000000？嘿...那是古老的異教節日。你知道，在新年和聖誕節出現之前，人們就會慶祝它。

scripts.text: My sisters say that all the gifts should look the same way. Or else some children might fight for fancy ones!
scripts.translation: 我妹妹們說所有禮物都應該包得一樣。否則孩子們可能會為了漂亮的禮物打起來！

scripts.text: Would you like me to wrap your fancy gift boxes with a gray paper?
scripts.translation: 要我用灰色包裝紙包好你的精美禮品盒嗎？

scripts.text: I don't see any gifts in fancy boxes on you...
scripts.translation: 我沒看到你身上有裝著禮物的精美禮品盒...

scripts.text: I wish you find my sisters ASAP... They need help.
scripts.translation: 希望你能儘快找到我的妹妹們...她們需要幫助。

scripts.text: Hi! I'm waithing for my sister's birdy with mail...
scripts.translation: 嗨！我在等姐姐寄來的信鴿...

scripts.text: I wish I had 4 more gray Gift Boxes for native children...
scripts.translation: 要是我有另外4個灰色禮品盒送給當地的孩子就好了...

scripts.text: Oh, hello. Has my brother Snower told you everything?
scripts.translation: 哦，你好。我哥哥斯諾爾都告訴你了嗎？
我不認識什麼斯諾哈特...

scripts.text: Gimme 4 gifts for poor kids... Wait, you haven't got 4 of them!
scripts.translation: 給窮孩子4份禮物...等等，你沒有4份禮物！

scripts.text: Thank you! Here's my li'l something for you!
scripts.translation: 謝謝！這是我送你的一點小禮物！

scripts.text: By the way, if you put on 2 different rings then your holidays leveling would be easier!
scripts.translation: 順便說一句，如果你戴上兩枚不同的戒指，節日等級提升會更容易！

scripts.text: Thanks again! No children will meet the holidays without the gifts!
scripts.translation: 再次感謝！沒有孩子會在沒有禮物的情況下迎接節日！

scripts.text: Pity... I've got a magic Santa's ring... I'd exchange it for 4 Gift Boxes...
scripts.translation: 真可惜...我有一枚魔法聖誕戒指...我願意用它交換4個禮品盒...

scripts.text: Helloooou! Do you know my bro and sis? How so? My brother Snower's well known in Prontera!! Just ask any child there.
scripts.translation: 哈嘍！你認識我哥哥和妹妹嗎？怎麼會呢？我哥哥斯諾爾在普隆德拉可是很有名的！！去問問那裡的孩子就知道了。

scripts.text: Darn... How could poor children be more important than the marine folks.. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation: 真可惡...窮孩子怎麼會比海洋居民更重要呢...我說得沒錯吧？

scripts.text: Errr. Helloou there. My sister Sneewy's sent me a birdie message. The letter was wet and I couldn't read anything but some ending letters of her address...
scripts.translation: 呃，你好呀。我妹妹斯紐伊給我寄來了一隻信鴿。信被弄溼了，我只看清了地址末尾的幾個字母...

scripts.text: Look, it's something like 'yang' in the very end... Hmm... She must be misspelled 'Al Doo Boryang'...
scripts.translation: 你看，最後好像是“揚”...嗯...她一定把“阿爾杜巴揚”拼錯了...

scripts.text: You've helped my sis? It's just great!
But I too need 3 more gifts for my marine folk friends...
scripts.translation: 不過我也還需要3份禮物送給海洋居民朋友...

scripts.text: I need a li'l something in return
Oops!! You haven't got 3 gray gift boxes on you.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！！你身上沒有3個灰色禮品盒。

scripts.text: Thaank yoouu! Have this magic ring!
scripts.translation: 謝——謝——你！這是送你的魔法戒指！

scripts.text: Oh... the whole marine folk send you their thanks! They love presents so much!!!
scripts.translation: 哦...所有海洋居民都托我向你道謝！他們太喜歡禮物了！！！

scripts.text: Didn't you know that Santa's Hat reveals the real power of the rings?
scripts.translation: 你不知道聖誕帽能顯現戒指真正的力量嗎？

scripts.text: I'd exchange a GOLD magic ring for 3 gift boxes...
scripts.translation: 我願意用一枚金色魔法戒指交換3個禮品盒...
